Neonatal seizures, neonatal withdrawal syndrome, fetal death, and stillbirth have all been reported. Tramadol is also not recommended during or immediately before labor. It should only be used in pregnancy if the benefits outweigh the risks. If you are already taking tramadol and become pregnant, do not stop taking it without talking to your healthcare provider, as stopping suddenly can be harmful to you both.
